annotations.text:
Main direction: Light Studio (light by default, dark via the toggle in the header - click it, it works).
Brand indigo #4F46E5 as accent, amber for the second speaker, Syne + Manrope type, Noto Nastaliq for Urdu.
3D: rotating sound cube, orbiting language ring, floating transcript stack, isometric step tiles, tilt-on-hover feature cards.
Accent chip changes the brand colour; Live demo chip switches the hero transcript to Urdu. The two sketches below-right are alternates, not finished pages.
